```{r Load in Libraries}
# Load in Libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tmap)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
```

```{r Read in OHI region boundaries}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) |> st_make_valid()
```
## Read in all habitat data
```{r Read in habitat services data}
# Read in habitat services data
habitat_services_full <- read_csv(here::here("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/HS_components_df_Sep112026.csv"))
```

# Calculating the HS_current_status:

```{r Calculate HS_current_status sub-scores}
colnames(habitat_services_full)

# Calculate carbon, filtration, and protection score
HS_current_status <- habitat_services_full |>
  group_by(rgn_id) |>
  summarise(
    PRO_score = sum(extent * coastal_protection * current_status, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    sum(extent * coastal_protection, na.rm = TRUE),

    FIL_score = sum(extent * filtration * current_status, na.rm = TRUE) /
                       sum(extent * filtration, na.rm = TRUE),

    SEQ_score = sum(extent * carbon_sequestration_gC.m2.yr * current_status, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    sum(extent * carbon_sequestration_gC.m2.yr, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

HS_current_status
```

```{r Calculate HS_current_status based on sub-scores}
# Average the 3 scores to get final OHI score
HS_current_status <- HS_current_status |>
  mutate(HS_score = (SEQ_score + FIL_score + PRO_score) / 3)

HS_current_status
```

```{r Fill out the HS_current_status for all years 2020 through 2025 which we have data}
HS_current_status_2 <- HS_current_status %>%
  crossing(year = 2020:2025) %>%
  arrange(rgn_id, year)

# NOTE TO SELF: I made this dataframe (Sep 11 2026). This will change once we settle the debate on trend. - EMF

```


```{r Save HS_current_status}
write.csv(HS_current_status_2,
          "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/HS_current_status_Sep112026.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r HS_current_status}
# Ignore NAs
HS_current_status <- HS_current_status |>
  mutate(HS_score = rowMeans(
    cbind(SEQ_score, FIL_score, PRO_score),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))

# Make a nice table
HS_current_status |>
  mutate(
    rgn_id = gsub("Region_", "Region ", rgn_id),        # remove "Region_" prefix
    SEQ_score = round(SEQ_score, 0),
    FIL_score = round(FIL_score, 0),
    PRO_score = round(PRO_score, 0),
    HS_score = round(HS_score, 0)
  ) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Region",
      "Carbon Score",
      "Filtration Score",
      "Coastal Score",
      "Habitat Services Score"
    )
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c("OHI Scores – Current Status" = 5))

```


```{r Plot HS_current_status}

# Region colors
rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region 1" = "#C03729",
  "Region 2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region 3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region 4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region 5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region 6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region 7" = "#747428",
  "Region 8" = "#627391",
  "Region 9" = "#8d61a9"
)

# Prepare data: remove underscores + convert to factor
HS_current_status_plot <- HS_current_status %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id),
    rgn_id = factor(rgn_id),
    HS_score = round(HS_score, 0)
  )

ggplot(HS_current_status_plot, aes(
  x = rgn_id,
  y = HS_score,
  fill = rgn_id
)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = HS_score),
    hjust = -0.2,        # moves text slightly to the right of the bar
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rgn_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Habitat Services Current Status Scores",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Current Status Score (0–100)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  ylim(0, max(HS_current_status$HS_score) * 1.15)


```



```{r Make a table for HS_current_status}
HS_current_status_clean <- HS_current_status |>
  mutate(
    rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id),
    SEQ_score = round(SEQ_score, 1),
    FIL_score = round(FIL_score, 1),
    PRO_score = round(PRO_score, 1),
    HS_score = round(HS_score, 1)
  )

HS_current_status_table <- HS_current_status_clean |>
  left_join(
    ohi_regions |> 
      filter(location == "marine") |> 
      select(rgn_id, ecorgn),
    by = "rgn_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ecorgn = gsub("_", " ", ecorgn),
    ecorgn = case_when(
      rgn_id == "Region 1" ~ "Western Upper Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 2" ~ "Western Midriff Islands",
      rgn_id == "Region 3" ~ "Western Central Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 4" ~ "Western Southern Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 5" ~ "Eastern Upper Gulf",
      rgn_id == "Region 6" ~ "Eastern Midriff Islands",
      rgn_id == "Region 7" ~ "Eastern Sonora Coast",
      rgn_id == "Region 8" ~ "Sinaloa Coast",
      rgn_id == "Region 9" ~ "Southeastern Gulf",
      TRUE ~ ecorgn
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    rgn_id,
    ecorgn,
    SEQ_score,
    FIL_score,
    PRO_score,
    HS_score
  )

```

```{r Clean the HS_current_status_table}
HS_current_status_table |>
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c(
      "Region ID",
      "Region Name",
      "Carbon Score",
      "Filtration Score",
      "Coastal Score",
      "Habitat Services Score"
    )
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c("OHI Habitat Services – Current Status" = 6))

```

```{r Map HS_current_status}
# 1. DO NOT remove underscores before joining
HS_current_status_clean <- HS_current_status |>
  mutate(
    HS_score = round(HS_score, 0)
  )

# 2. Join onto OHI polygons
ohi_habitat_current_status <- ohi_regions |>
  left_join(HS_current_status_clean, by = "rgn_id")

# 3. Split marine vs land
ohi_marine <- ohi_habitat_current_status |> filter(location == "marine")
ohi_land   <- ohi_habitat_current_status |> filter(location == "land")

# 4. Map
tmap_mode("plot")

HS_current_status_map<- tm_shape(ohi_land) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "#f5e6c8",
    border.col = "gray40",
    lwd = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +

tm_shape(ohi_marine) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "HS_score",
    palette = "RdYlGn",
    alpha = 0.8,
    title = "Habitat Services OHI Score",
    border.col = "black",
    lwd = 1.2
  ) +

tm_layout(
  title = "OHI Habitat Services – Current Status",
  frame = FALSE,
  legend.outside = TRUE
)

HS_current_status_map
```


# Calculating the final HS_trend from PRO, FIL, and SEQ sub-scores:
# NOTE TO SELF (Sep 11 2026): I am deeply skeptical about this calculation of trend. For starters, I think the trend column includes NAs that MIGHT need to be zeros; I also think -- critically -- trend should be calculated per habitat type and then averaged.

```{r Calculate HS_trend}

colnames(habitat_services_full)

# Calculate carbon, filtration, and protection score
HS_trend <- habitat_services_full |>
  group_by(rgn_id) |>
  summarise(
    SEQ_score = sum(extent * carbon_sequestration_gC.m2.yr * trend, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    sum(extent * carbon_sequestration_gC.m2.yr, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    FIL_score = sum(extent * filtration * trend, na.rm = TRUE) /
                       sum(extent * filtration, na.rm = TRUE)* 100,

    PRO_score = sum(extent * coastal_protection * trend, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    sum(extent * coastal_protection, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )

HS_trend
```

```{r HS_final_trend}
# Average the 3 scores to get final OHI score
HS_final_trend <- HS_trend |>
  mutate(HS_score = (SEQ_score + FIL_score + PRO_score) / 3)

HS_final_trend
```

```{r Make a table for HS_trend}
# Ignore NA values
HS_trend <- HS_trend |>
  mutate(HS_score = rowMeans(
    cbind(SEQ_score, FIL_score, PRO_score),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))

# Make a nice table
HS_trend |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Region",
      "Carbon Trend",
      "Filtration Trend",
      "Coastal Trend",
      "Habitat Services Trend"
    )
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c("OHI Scores – Trend" = 5))

```

```{r Save HS_trend as csv}
write.csv(HS_trend,
          "/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/HS/v2026/HS_Scores_1.1/HS_trend_Sep112026_DRAFT.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
